name: Thornton SB
description: Thornton State Beach in Daly City is currently closed to the public. There is no beach access, but a viewing platform just west of the parking lot overlooks the coast.
fullDescription: Thornton State Beach in Daly City is currently closed to the public. There is no beach access, but a viewing platform just west of the parking lot overlooks the coast.
whatTheyOffer:

- The Bay Area Ridge Trail starts nearby on Mayfair Drive
howToGetIt: The beach is closed and there is no beach access. Check the California State Parks page for reopening updates before visiting.
